name: Irisome Ryuusei
source:
Birth year: 2032

Main character of episode 1
[url=/c92637]Rei[/url]'s childhood friend. Being the two only children in the village, he and Rei quickly get along with each other. The two go explore the village's dumpsite as a weekly routine.
Similar to [url=/c92637]Rei[/url], Ryuusei also dreams of starting his own journey into the outer world, hence the determination of defeating [url=/c92646]Mikage[/url]. Later on in the story, [spoiler]he is revealed to be successful in fulfilling his dream, 1 year earlier than Rei.[/spoiler]
Has a mischievous personality. Always tease Rei for being too weak to become his companion.
